issues.description: Method name mismatch for clearing the stock: the problem statement UML lists a Stock method named emptyStock(), and the reference solution implements emptyStock() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java, but the template starter code provides a method named clearInventory() instead. This naming inconsistency (emptyStock vs. clearInventory) can confuse students who will follow the UML/spec and look for emptyStock(), and may cause them to add or rename methods to reconcile the two APIs.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution. Rename the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock() (preserving its behavior), or add a new public emptyStock() method in the template that delegates to the existing clearInventory(). Update any in-repo references if necessary so students see the expected emptyStock() method name from the UML.
